# Where to find and how to farm for Salt, Pepper, and Spices in Fallout 76: The Mire

Dedicated to Sergeant. Thank you for once again breaking my heart. Speaking with you is bittersweet every time </3 XD

There are two types of condiment spawns in Fallout 76.

One is a fixed spawn, for example, Pepper will always spawn at that location.

The other type of spawn is an "Any spawn". An "Any" spawn can be either Salt, Pepper, Sugar, or Spices.

I will note at each location if there are any "Any" spawns and how many there are at that location.

In The Mire, there are:

29x Any spawns

32x Salt spawns

22x Pepper spawns

15x Spices spawns

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

Salt and Pepper are a per server, pick-up history list item.

You can find the guide here if you don't know what any of that means.

No perk cards or magazines affect the yield of Salt and Pepper. It is unfortunately a one-for-one farm.

Thru-Hiker Perk Card under Agility and the Grocery Backpack from the Settlers can reduce the weight of Salt and Pepper.

Avoid using explosive weapons as the condiments can move. If the condiments do move and you can't find them, fast travel out of the cell, the next map icon over is fine and then come back. The cell should have reset and the condiments will be back in their spawn locations.

__Fixed Spawn Locations__

I have used a mod on custom world to make the condiments easier to see in each photo.

**Freddy Fear's House of Scares**

You will need lock-pick perk cards or the Master Infiltrator Legendary Perk Card to access some of these locations.

7x Any

Walk around the edge of the building until you get to the diner entrance on the Northern end of the building. Enter the diner and head to the blue door marked "Kitchen Employees Only". Open the door and enter the kitchen. There are spawns on the countertops as well as on the metal shelf on the right-hand side of the room.

**Red Rocket Mega Stop**

5x Salt

3x Pepper

1x Spices

You will need to run over to the Red Rocket workshop from Freddy Fear's House of Scares. Keep running West, up the road, until you get to a Yellow School Bus parked on the main road. Jump on top of the school bus and turn North. Run forward until you get to the corner of the building. Turn NW and enter the orange door on the building opposite you. You should now be in the kitchen.

Check the countertops and the metal shelves above the countertops.

The next spawn is in the second kitchen, on the counter, near the Vault 76 Stash Box.

Turn West and enter the dining room area. The remaining spawns can be found in the middle of the area, on the diner booth tables that run from North to South.

**Abandoned Bunker**

Internal

1x Any

Inside the bunker, downstairs, in the kitchen, on the bench, next to the sink.

**Southhampton Estate**

1x Any

Inside the house on the right. In the kitchen, on the bench, next to the sink.

**Crevasse Dam**

1x Any

From the spawn in location, run around to the back of the dam (North). The dam is split into left and right by the concrete bridge in the middle. On the left side, walk North until you are on the edge of the rock face. Directly opposite you will be a small campsite. Either run around or jetpack over to the campsite and the spawn is next to the cooking station.

**Dolly Sods Wilderness**

3x Any

First spawn location: In the first building from the fast travel location, in the Gift Shop on the right, on the back shelf on the South wall.

Second spawn location: In the second building at the back, in the kitchen, on the bench, next to the fridge.

Third spawn location: Stand at the back door of the second building and look South. To your right will be two trees. Look for the tree that is larger than the others and has orange vines growing on it. Run over to that tree and follow the ramp to the top. The spawn is next to the white suitcase.

**Mosstown**

2x Any

3x Salt

2x Pepper

1x Spices

Mosstown can be painful to find items due to the fissure site and enemy spawns. I recommend clearing the area and disposing of the Scorchbeast first, fast travelling away so the cell can reset, and then coming back.

First spawn location: From the spawn in location, run forward and cross the bridge. At the end of the bridge, look to your right, you should see a sign "Fun Stuff" on the wall. Walk forward and carefully jump over the wall. The spawns will be on the dining tables in front of you.

Second spawn location: In the dining area, turn East and look for the set of stairs. Follow the stairs to the top, veer left, and keep walking forward until you hit the wooden wall. The spawns are on top of the bookcases on either side of the red trunk.

Third spawn location: Turn around and face North. Walk towards the bottom of the set of stairs and then turn West. Walk forward and follow the stairs to the bottom. Turn North and walk up the stairs and enter the small building. The spawns are on the metal shelf, on the Northern wall.

Fourth spawn location: Turn around and exit the building. Jump and stand on top of the building and face West. You should be directly facing another building with a set of stairs out the front. Jump down and run over to that building and go inside. The spawns are on the dining tables inside.

Turn North and walk out the doorway at the back. Follow the building around and there is another spawn on the edge of the BBQ.

There are no condiment spawns in the second complex near the fissure site but there is some good loot in there so it's worth running over and having a look.

**Dyer Chemical**

1x Salt

1x Pepper

From the Fast Travel location, run South and take the road on the right. Follow the footpath on the right-hand side of the road until you get to a set of concrete stairs on your right.

Turn West and walk forward until you get to the back of the building.

Turn South and walk over to the set of concrete stairs in front of you. Keep walking South and stop at the Yellow Forklift.

Turn East and you should be looking at a blue door. Walk over, open the door, and turn South and the spawns should be on the cabinets in front of you, on the Southern wall.

**Raleigh Clay's Bunker**

1x Salt

1x Pepper

1x Spices

From the spawn-in location, turn SE and run forward. Make sure that the church is on your left when you run past it and keep going forward. Just past the church is a clearing with a large metal power pylon in the middle. Run over to the pylon and look for a doorway. Enter the complex and look for the kitchen area. One spawn is on the metal shelf on the right wall, another on top of the overhead kitchen cabinets, and the last spawn is on the dining table on the left.

**The Retreat**

2x Any

4x Salt

3x Pepper

2x Spices

From the fast travel point, face West. The Retreat is split up into three sections. entrance left, entrance middle, and entrance right. Turn NW and run over to the entrance right. Look for the red truck with the yellow ramp going up. Follow the ramp and the stairs up until you are standing in the middle of the first room.

First spawn location: Turn South and walk over the bridge. You should now be in a kitchen/dining area. There are two spawns here, one on the diner booth table against the South wall and another on the kitchen bench, near the red cooking station.

Second spawn location: Stand at the red cooking station and turn North. Walk up the stairs on your left. Turn left, walk forward a few steps, and then face East. Walk forward, across the bridge, and enter the room. Face North and the spawn is in front of you, on the table. The other spawn is on the dining table on your right.

Third spawn location: Turn around, go back down the stairs, and stand at the doorway near the red cooking station. Face South, and cross the bridge. Take the bridge on the left and enter the building. There are 3 spawn locations here. Check the left side of the room.

And the right side of the room, near the posters on the wall.

Fourth spawn location: Use the doorway on the South side of the room and cross the bridge. The last spawn is on the table, in the corner of the room.

**Bloody Frank's**

3x Salt

1x Pepper

It is worth clearing the enemies from this location first, fast travelling away, and then coming back again as the condiments will go flying.

From the spawn-in location, turn slightly left and run forward until you get to a pile of green barricades. Jump over or walk around and take the stairs up to the top.

First spawn location: Keep following the path around (there is only one way you can go) until you get to the flamer trap on your right. Walk past the trap and turn right. Go down the stairs and follow the path around. Cross the bridge and walk down the stairs. The first spawn is on the table, in the corner, in front of you.

Second spawn location: Turn East and enter the building. There is another spawn on your left, on the table, just past the Nuka-Cola Machine.

Third spawn location: Keep walking East to the middle of the kitchen and then turn North. There is a spawn on the metal shelves near the cooking station and another spawn on the patio table in the NE corner. Once you have finished looting, throw a Molotov cocktail at the blue stove.

From this location, turn and ran over to the Berkeley Springs West workshop map marker.

**Berkeley Springs West (Workshop)**

1x Salt

1x Pepper

Enter the workshop and look for the red car on the main road. Stand at the front of the red car and face West. Jump up onto the roof of the building in front of you. You should be able to see a cooking station and some workbenches. The spawn is near the cooking station, on the metal shelf.

**Dagger's Den**

2x Any

1x Salt

1x Pepper

1x Spices

First spawn location: From the Fast Travel point, look straight ahead and you should be facing the end of a yellow school bus. Run over to the bus and go inside. The spawn is on the metal table at the back of the bus.

Second spawn location: Exit the bus and turn West. Walk forward and follow the path on the right. Turn left at the fence on your left and continue to follow the path. Go up the stairs on your left and follow the path around to the bar (first room). The spawn is on the makeshift bar, next to the silver metal fridge.

Third spawn location: Face North and drop down to the ground floor. Turn West and exit via the yellow door.

Stop outside the door and turn North. Walk forward until you hit the rock wall.

Turn left and take the stairs up. Go through the doorway and turn East.

Jump or jetpack up the walls and rocks until you are standing on the edge of the rock wall. Follow the rock wall past the Radstag corpses and stop at the Raider Lookout Tower in front of you. The spawn is on the cabinet, at the top of the Raider Tower.

**Dagger's Den**

Internal

1x Any

2x Salt

2x Pepper

2x Spices

From the Raider Lookout Tower, face South and jump down to the ground. Turn North and you should be in front of the door leading to Dagger's Den. Interact with the door and load inside.

First spawn location: Follow the path and stay on the top level. Keep walking until you see a Power Armour station on your left. There is a wall on the North side of the Power Armour station. The spawn is on top of the wooden crates, behind the large toolbox, behind the wall.

Second spawn location: Face West and jump down to the ground. Turn North and the next spawn will be in front of you, on top of a wooden crate, in front of some couches/sofas.

Third spawn location: Turn NW and walk over to the set of stairs in front of you. Walk up the stairs and turn right. Follow the path to the end and the last spawn is on top of the wooden crates on your left, behind the blue cooler.

**Sunday Brothers' Cabin**

You will need lock-pick perk cards or the Master Infiltrator Legendary Perk Card to access some of these locations.

1x Salt

2x Pepper

2x Spices

First spawn location: Inside the main building, on the counter.

Second spawn location: Behind the counter in the main house is a set of stairs leading down to a locked door. Unlock the level 1 door and the spawns are on the metal shelves in front of you.

**The Burrows**

Internal

Enter via The Burrows South.

2x Any

3x Salt

1x Pepper

1x Spices

First spawn location: From the load-in point, veer right, walk off the platform, and stand in the tunnel. Walk straight and turn left so you are standing in the main tunnel.

Go to your left and follow the path. Turn left and stop at the bottom of the stairs.

Turn left and follow the path around, past the red machinery on your right. Stop at the bottom of the stairs and face East. You should be looking at a sign on the wall that says "Mess Hall". Go up the stairs and walk straight. The spawn will be right in front of you, on the cinder block table.

Second spawn location: Keep walking East (jump over the table), until you get to the orange BBQ/Grill. Turn right, walk forward, jump into the water, and walk up the stairs on the other side. At the top of the stairs, walk straight, through the doorway in front of you and down the stairs on the other side. Turn left and follow the path until you get to the pile of rocks blocking your way. Look North and you will see a wooden wall marked "Keep out". Walk over to the wall and go through the pipe on the right.

Follow the path straight until you get to a security gate and a red light. There is a sign next to the gate saying "Do Not Enter". Turn left and stop at the second corner of the first building on your left. Face SW and walk forward. You will see a set of stairs on your right. The next spawn is next to the stairs.

Third spawn location: Walk up the stairs on your right, face East, and follow the path around. Enter the shack and the spawn is on your right, on the table, in the left-hand side bedroom.

Fourth spawn location: Turn NW and walk forward. Go up the stairs and follow the path until you see the Yellow Portable Stove in front of you. The spawn is next to the stove, on the metal shelf.

Fifth spawn location: Face South and walk down the stairs. At the bottom of the stairs, walk forward, around the wall, and then turn right. Keep walking straight until you see a pipe on your left and a wooden fence in front of you. Turn West and you will see a red door marked "Market". Walk over to the door and interact with the chains.

Open the door and walk forward until you get to the pipe on the other side of the room. Jump up to the platform above or take the stairs on your right.

Follow the path around until you hit the wall. The spawn is on your right, on the green table, in the corner.

Sixth spawn location: Turn around and walk back along the path. Stop at the broken display case on your left. Turn right and drop down to the ground.

Turn NE and look up. There will be another platform in the corner. Walk over and jump up onto the platform. The other spawn is on top of the brown bookcase.

**Tanagra Town**

4x Any

1x Salt

First spawn location: Follow the road towards Tanagra Town and stop at the house on your right. Walk around to the back of the house and enter via the back door. There is one spawn on the kitchen bench and another on the floor, in front of the table.

Second spawn location: Jump in your Power Armour or equip max rank Goat Legs perk card under Agility because it's time to climb.

Climb to the top of Tanagra Town. When you are near the top, there is a set of concrete stairs at the end of a tree trunk.

Walk up the stairs and keep heading South until you hit a dirt wall. Very carefully jump up to the next level. On your right should be an entrance to a cave.

Veer left slightly and keep walking and jumping South. Jump over the metal debris and follow the rock ramp up to the ruined house.

At the top of the ramp, veer right and enter the doorway. Turn South and walk out of the house through the hole in the wall.

Turn North and you will see the spawn on the metal shelf, below the Brain Fungus spawn.

Third spawn location: Turn South and carefully walk over to the ruined house in front of you. Go up the green stairs on your right and enter the house. Stand in the doorway and look South and you will see the spawn on the floor, near the Southern wall.

Fourth spawn location: From the top, fast travel back to Tanagra Town (it's faster than climbing back down).

From the fast travel point, turn East and run forward, past the red ruined shed and the base of Tanagra Town. Continue running East until you get to the large shed. Run around the shed until you find the door at the back, near the packed cars.

The spawn is in the first room, in the lockers on your right.

**Delano Grange**

1x Any

Run or fast travel over to Delano Grange.

Enter the ruined house on your left. The spawn is in the corner, on the top wooden shelf.

**Harpers Ferry Tunnel**

1x Any

You will need to get your feet wet and go for a swim to grab this spawn.

From the spawn-in location, Turn West and follow the train tracks until you get to the start of the metal beams over the bridge. Turn South and jump into the water. Swim South until you get to a small dirt island. Turn East and swim until you see a tree house, taken over by orange vines. Climb up the ramp of the tree house and the spawn is on the first level, on the corner of the metal shelf, near the skeleton.

**Ransacked Bunker**

Internal

1x Salt

1x Pepper

Swim to the bunker from the above spawn location. Enter the bunker and take the stairs down to the bottom.

First spawn location: Open the blue door and turn South. Walk up into the kitchen and turn left. The spawn is on the dining table in front of you.

Second spawn location: Turn SW and walk over to the counter in the corner and the spawn is on the edge of the counter.

**Big B's Rest Stop**

1x Salt

1x Pepper

1x Spices

From the fast travel point, face West and run over to the Super Duper Mart building.

First spawn location: Enter the building and turn right. Walk towards the market shelves in front of you. The spawn is on the back of the first set of market shelves.

Second spawn location: Walk straight toward the end of the building and stop at the coffee station. Behind the coffee station, on the diner booth table is the spawn.

**Valley Galleria**

Internal

1x Salt

1x Pepper

1x Spices

From the spawn-in location, run straight through the carpark and enter the Valley Galleria building.

First spawn location: Run straight, over the front counter and past the water fountain, until you can't go any further. On your left will be a small gap in the counter. Walk through the gap and turn right. Walk forward, into the kitchen, and the spawn is on your left, next to the stove.

Second spawn location: Face South and walk over to the blue door. Open the blue door and turn right. Stop at the end of the hall and look straight. There will be two escalators in front of you. Take the escalator on your right, (you will need to walk around to get to the front of it), and stop at the top.

Turn right and follow the path around. Stop at the "Little Italy" restaurant on your left. Turn left and enter the restaurant. Walk all the way to the back of the restaurant and enter the kitchen.

The spawn is on the kitchen counter, in the corner, next to the sink.

**Treetops**

1x Any

From the spawn in location, run straight and stop at the base of the stairs in front of you. Turn and go up the stairs. Keep climbing up the tree house using the sets of stairs. There is only one way you can go. Stop on the platform that has the yellow portable stove on top of a makeshift bench, on your right. The spawn is on the makeshift bench, next to the stove.

**Moth-Home**

2x Salt

1x Spices

Run over to the Moth-Home from Treetops. Keep running straight, jump over the rocks, and drop down into the middle of the area.

First spawn location: From the middle of Moth-Home, turn SW and walk up the stairs. Turn right and walk forward a few steps. The spawn is on top of the wooden crate, on your left.

Second spawn location: Turn and face West. You should see a red and white large metal power pylon in the distance. Run over to the power pylon and stand beneath it. Turn South and follow the power lines to the next pylon. As you go past the Phosphate Deposit pit, veer right so you are running on the top ledge of the cliff face in front of you. Keep running South/following the power lines until you get to the Red Dump Truck.

**Camp Venture**

You will need lock-pick perk cards or the Master Infiltrator Legendary Perk Card to access some of these locations.

1x Pepper

1x Spices

From the fast travel point, run straight towards Camp Venture and stop at the third cabin on your right. This is the same cabin that you turn Technical Data in. Enter the cabin and take the stairs down to the basement (Southern Corner of the room). Open the level 1 locked blue door and the spawn is directly in front of you, at the bottom of the metal shelf on the left.

**Blakes Offering**

1x Salt

From the spawn-in location, run up the hill and stop at the first platform on your left. It will have a whale skeleton spine on one end. The spawn is on the ground near the white suitcase.
